title: Native browser startup publishes stale resource ownership and reconnects reuse the original accountant
causalEvidence: Two original-source Worker regressions publish obsolete runtimes. The unchanged application replay rejects the complete old package. A separate private observation script around that same old graph finds nine stale published live Workers and two reconnects bypassing current admission. The existing Local provider already refuses the profile/required case; this is retained as a positive protection check, not counted as a newly discovered failure.
behavior: Capture the initiating Agent and original resource Service before browser startup waits. Recheck across local activation, profile preparation, subprocess dispatch, Worker admission and readiness; return unused original grants and retain retryable completion errors. Fresh reconnects capture current admission while existing Chromium ranges keep their original permits.

verification.coverageLimits: Three named source modules at all four 100% metrics, with no coverage-policy or exclusion changes. Existing built-entry exclusion is exercised through actual plain-Node Workers on Node22/24.
verification.runtimes: Source and built Node24 replay both the new startup owner application and existing native-browser SDK transcript; built Node22 replays the new application.

evidenceSetupCorrection: The first application fixture installed external browser module hooks before boot and hung during Loader initialization. Installing those hooks after the base tree boots matches the existing native-browser example and passes. Failed setup and timeout receipts are preserved. A source Service identity access needed the existing typed Cordis-original helper with a plain-provider fallback; final build, source replay and coverage validate the corrected code. One pre-existing browser-model assertion was aligned with the current LLM unavailable-provider diagnostic.

noteReview.decision: Focused startup-versus-reconnect admission ownership; existing browser runtime architecture and frozen archived notes remain unchanged.
